# Pull request

## Problem and change

<!-- Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and why this approach fits.
Link the relevant issue; use "Closes #..." only if the PR fully resolves it. -->

## Validation

<!-- List commands and results. Include relevant device/browser or deployment
mode, manual flows tested, and any skipped checks or unverified behavior.
For Go integration tests, state whether VIRTROID_TEST_DATABASE_URL was set.
For documentation-only changes, link and formatting checks are enough. -->

## Risks and operational impact

<!-- Describe security/privacy effects, migrations, compatibility, configuration,
deployment steps, and rollback limits when relevant. Write "None" if applicable.
Do not include credentials, private runtime contents, or exploit details for an
undisclosed vulnerability; use SECURITY.md for private reporting. -->

## UI or accessibility changes

<!-- If relevant, describe the changed flow and accessibility checks. Sanitized
screenshots are useful but optional. Otherwise write "Not applicable". -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md][contributing] and the
  [Code of Conduct][conduct].
- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change and documented gaps above.
- [ ] I updated documentation and regression coverage where needed, or explained
  why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I preserved upstream notices and kept secrets and generated distribution
  artifacts out of this PR.

[contributing]: https://github.com/mattyperrott/Virtroid/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
